name: guardbee_slopsquat_scanner_check_package
description: Check whether a package name exists on the real npm or PyPI registry.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: The exact package name to check (e.g. "react" or "@babel/core" for npm, "requests" for PyPI).

arguments.name: ecosystem
arguments.desc: Which registry to check — either "npm" or "PyPI".
